questions.question: Which of the following means "How do you sell this?"

choices.explanation: This means “Hello Boss”, which is a greeting to the stall owner.
This means “how do you sell this”, used to ask about the price of the dish
This means “how much do you want?”, used by the vendor to ask how much of something the buyer wants.
This means “What is this?”, you can use this to ask what others are eating or selling.

questions.question: Which of the following is traditionally offered as a worship food on the Qixi (Seven Sisters) Festival?

choices.explanation: Pineapple cake is a popular Taiwanese snack, but not the expected worship food here.

choices.text: 筒仔米糕 - tube rice pudding
choices.explanation: Tube rice pudding is not the expected worship food here.
Steamed taro cake is associated with other worship traditions.

choices.text: 白糖粿 - fried sweet rice cake
choices.explanation: Fried sweet rice cake (白糖粿) is fried sticky rice dough served with ground peanuts or sesame. It is a worship food for 七娘妈 (the Seven Star Lady), the goddess who protects couples and children under the age of sixteen. She is also known as 织女, the weaver girl from Chinese mythology who fell in love with the cowherd 牛郎. Because they broke the laws of heaven, they were separated by the Milky Way and may only meet on the seventh day of the seventh lunar month. This day is celebrated as 七夕节 (the Qixi or Seven Sisters Festival), now also known as Chinese Valentine's Day.
